content: Yesu iurpe mbesooŋo ta ki biibi kizin malmal kan
Yesu ikam sua tana pizin tomtom ma imap, to imaŋga ma ila pa kar Kapenaum.
Mi tomtom ta ki Rom, ta imborro zin wal malmal kan tomto lamata na, ni imbotmbot. Mi ni le mbesooŋo ambaiŋana ta, ta ni leleene pini ilip. Mi mbesooŋo tina, ni mete biibi ikami mabe imeete.
Tana indeeŋe biibi tana ileŋ Yesu uruunu, tona iŋgo zin kolman pakan kizin Yuda ma tila be tiso pa Yesu ma imar be iurpe mbesooŋo kini ma niini ambai.
Tana timar ki Yesu, mi titaŋroro i ma tiso: “Ou, ko irao be mar mi uulu tomtom tiŋga. Pa ni tomtom ambaiŋana.
Ni iur kat leleene piti Yuda, mi ipo leyam lupŋana muriini ta.”

To ziŋan Yesu timaŋga ma tila. Tigarau ruumu, mi biibi kizin malmal kan iŋgo wal kini pakan ma tila tiso pa Yesu. Tisombe: “Merere, biibi tiam iso pu ta kembei. Iso: ‘Mbuulu itum pa pai pepe. Pa nio tomtom ambaiŋoŋ som. Tana leleŋ be nu mar ruumu tio pepe.
Uunu tiŋgi tabe re, ituŋ irao aŋma som. Mi nio aŋurla ta kembei: Nu sombe ur sua men, na mbesooŋo tio ko niini ndabok.

Pa nio aŋute pa ituŋ. Nio ti aŋbot la zin bibip pakan kopon mbarman. Mi zin malmal kan pakan timbot la nio kopoŋ mbarmaana. Tana sombe aŋso pa tiŋgi ma aŋso: ‘La!’ nako ila. Mi sombe aŋso pa tiŋga: ‘Mar!’ nako imar. Mi sombe aŋso pa mbesooŋo tio: ‘Kam ta kembei.’ nako ikam.’”

Yesu ileŋ sua kizin tana na, imurur pa. To itoori mi iso pizin iwal ta titoto i na. Iso: “Nio aŋso kat piom. Nio aŋdeeŋe tomtom sa ki Israel ta urlaŋana kini imbol kembei wal taiŋgi biibi kizin na som.”
Tona zin wal ta biibi tana iŋgo zin ma tila na, timiili ma timar ruumu. Tipet ruumu na, tire mbesooŋo ki biibi tau, ni niini ambai ma imbotmbot.
Yesu ipei nora ta lutuunu ma imaŋga mini
Aigule toro na, Yesu imaŋga ma ila pa kar Nain. Mi zin naŋgaŋ kini ziŋan zin iwal biibi tito i ma tila.

Tila ma tigarau zaala kwoono ki kar, to tire wal pakan tisiŋ uri ta ma tizem kar mi timar. Tomtom meeteŋana tana, ina ra, nora lutuunu ta itutamenŋana. Tabe iwal biibi ki kar tina, tigaabi mi ziŋan tipa ma timar.
Merere ire nora tana ma leleene isaana pini. To iso lae pini. Iso: “A barau, taŋ pepe!”
Mi ipa ma ila ma iteege ke poŋana ta uri imbot sala na, to zin tomtom ta tisiŋi na tuŋ ma timbotmbot. Mi Yesu iso: “Naŋgaŋ, nio aŋso pu: Maŋga!”
To tomtom meeteŋana tana burup ma imaŋga, mi imbutul mi izzo sua. To Yesu ikami mi iuri ila ki naana.
Tabe motoŋana biibi ikam zin iwal, mi tiwit Anutu uruunu ma tiso: “Wai, iŋgi ko Anutu kwoono zaanaŋana ta imbotmbot mazwanda i. Iŋgi Anutu mataana iŋgal iti wal kini mi iuulu iti kek.”
Tana Yesu uruunu irak ma irao toono ta boozomen kizin Yuda mi kar zilŋanzilŋan tomini.
Yoan iŋgo naŋgaŋ kini ma tila ki Yesu
Yoan naŋgaŋ kini tila ma tiso Yoan pa mbulu boozomen ta Yesu ikamam na. Tabe Yoan iboobo naŋgaŋ kini ru,
mi iŋgo zin ma tila ki Merere be tiwi i ta kembei: “Ulaaŋa tabe imar i, ina nu tau? Som amsa tomtom toro sa?”
Tana ziru tila ma tipet ki Yesu, to tiso: “Yoan ta yok kamŋana tomtom na, iŋgo yam ma amar be amwi u: Ulaaŋa tabe imar i, nu tau? Som amsa tomtom toro sa?”
Indeeŋe mazwaana tana Yesu, ni iurpewe zin tomtom boozomen ta mete matakiŋa ikam zin na. Mi izirziiri bubuŋana sananŋan, mi iurpewe tomtom boozomen ta matan pisŋan na, ma tire lele mini.

Tana Yesu ipekel wiŋana kizin ma isombe: “Uraata ta kerre mi sua ta keleŋleŋ i, kimiili ma kala, to koso Yoan pa. Koso pini: Matan pisŋan tire lele, mi narapeŋan tipa, kulin mbetmbeeteŋan na, kulin iŋgeeze mini, talŋan munŋan tileŋ sua, meeteŋan timaŋga, mi uruunu ambaiŋana ilala pizin wal ta timbot ŋoobo na.
Mi tomtom ta so leleene iwe ru pio som, mi ikiskis urlaŋana kini, nako menmeeni pa kampeŋana ki Anutu tabe ise kini i.”

Yoan ŋgoŋana kini timiili ma tila, to Yesu iso pizin iwal biibi pa Yoan. Iso: “Indeeŋe ta niom kala lele bilimŋana be kere Yoan na, koso ko kere sokorei? Me wiini ta miiri ipamirri i? Som tomtom sa ta iru pa mburu ambaimbaiŋan? Ina som! Pa zin wal ta tirru pa mburu ambaimbaiŋan ta kadon bibip i, mi zin mbio uunu na, zin timbotmbot ruumu kizin king. Mi irao tizem murin ambaimbaiŋan tana na som.
Lak! Kena kala be kere sokorei? Anutu kwoono sa, na? Mi keleŋ. Nio aŋso kat piom: Yoan tina, ni zaana ruk ten ŋana pa Anutu kwoono bizin ta boozomen.
Ina ni ta tibeede ka sua pataaŋa kek ta kembei:

content.text: ‘Re. Nio ko aŋgo tomtom tasa be iwe kwoŋ.
Mi ni ko imuuŋgu mi iurpe zaala pu.’

content: Nio aŋso kat piom. Wal boozomen ta nan bizin tipeebe zin su toono ti na, tasa zaana biibi ma ilip pa Yoan na som. Tamen tomtom sorokŋana sa, isombe ikilaala kat peeze ki Anutu mi imbot lela, na ni ilip pa Yoan.”
Tomtom ta munŋaana men ziŋan zin wal ta tiyyo takesŋan i, tileŋ sua tana na, tikam ŋgar pa mi tiso: “O Anutu, mbulu kini, ina indeeŋe men.” Pa zin tiurla sua ki Yoan mi tikam yok kek.
Tamen zin tutu kan mi zin ŋgarŋan ki tutu na, titit uraata ta Anutu isombe ikam pizin. Pa tiurla sua ki Yoan som, tana tikam yok som.
Yesu ikam sua tooroŋana ma iso: “Iŋgi ko aŋso parei pizin wal ta koozi timbotmbot i? Wal ti pareiŋan?
Zin kembei pikin ta timbutultul isu kar keteene, mi tiboboobo la pa waen bizin ma tiso:
“Pa Yoan, ta yok kamŋana ka tomtom na, ni imar na iwinin baen som mi igabgaaba zin tomtom pa kini biibi kanŋana som. Mi niom leleyom pini som, mi kosombe ni bubuŋana sananŋana izeebi.

To Tomtom Lutuunu imar mi ikanan ma iwinin. Tamen niom leleyom pini som tomini, mi kosombe: ‘Iŋgi to tau igabgaaba zin wal sananŋan mi zin tau tiyyo takesŋan i, mi ziŋan timbel kini kanŋana mi baen winŋana’.
Tamen Anutu ŋgar kini, ina biibi mi indeeŋe men. Tana zin tomtom ta titoto ŋgar ki Anutu na, zin tikilaala kembei ŋgar tana, ina indeeŋe men.”
Mbulu ta tomtom tutu kana ta mi moori sananŋana ta tikam pa Yesu
Zin tutu kan, tomtom kizin ta, zaana Simon, iso pa Yesu be ila ruumu kini ma ziŋan tikan kini. Yesu ila ma ziŋan mbulen su pa kini kanŋana.
Moori ta ki kar tana, ni moori sananŋana. Ileŋ kembei Yesu imbotmbot la ruumu ki tomtom tana pa kini kanŋana, to ikam ŋgere kuziiniŋana mi ila.
Ila to mbuleene isu ta Yesu kumbuunu uunu, mi itaŋtaŋ ma mata luluunu itoptop se Yesu kumbuunu. Mana imus pa ute ruunu, mi imbeŋbeeŋe pini. To isu na, iliŋ ŋgere kuziiniŋana ise Yesu kumbuunu.

Ruumu katuunu ta iboobo Yesu ma ila na, ni ire mbulu tina, to iso pa itunu. Iso: “Wai, sombe tomtom tiŋgi, ni Anutu kwoono ŋonoono, so ikilaala moori ta itekteegi na kek. Pa ni sa moori sananŋana na.”
Yesu isu mi iso: “Simon, nio leŋ sua ri tabe aŋso pu.” Simon iso: “Mos katuunu, so lak!”
To Yesu iso: “Tomtom ru tila ki tomtom ta, mi tikam mbun la kini. Ta ikam pius tomtooru laamuru, toro ikam pius lamata.
Tamen kaimer ziru len pat sa be tikot som. To tomtom tana imuŋai zin, mi iyembut mbun kizin ma imborene. Lak, wal ru tana, iŋgoi ko leleene pa tomtom tana ilip?”
Simon iso: “Inako tomtom ta ikam mbun biibi mi koroŋ katuunu imuŋai i na.” Mi Yesu iso: “Ambai, nu so kat.”

To itoori ma kereene ila ki moori tau, mi iso pa Simon: “Lak, nu so pio, ta aŋmar ruumu ku ti. Tamen nu kam leŋ yok sa be aŋguuru kumbuŋ? Som. Mi re moori ti. Ni iŋguuru kumbuŋ pa mata luluunu mi imus pa ute ruunu.
Mi nu mbeŋbeeŋe pio som. Mi ni na, imbeli. Pa indeeŋe ta aŋle aŋbot ti na, ni imbeŋbeeŋe pa kumbuŋ mi inoknok men i.
Mi nu liŋ ŋgere risa isala uteŋ som. Tamen ni na, iliŋ ŋgere kuziiniŋana ise kumbuŋ.

“Tana nio aŋso pu. Ŋonoono, moori ti sanaana kini biibi. Tamen sanaana kini ta boozomen, nio aŋreege ma imap lup. Tanata ni iur kat leleene pio. Mi ni ta indemeere ma isombe le sanaana musaari, inako iur kat leleene pio som.”
To Yesu iso pa moori tana: “Sanaana ku ta boozomen, nio aŋreege kek.”
Tabe wal ta ziŋan tikanan na, tikam ŋgar boozo ma tiso: “To ti, ni asiŋ ta iso ni irao be ireege sanaana?”
Mi Yesu iso pa moori: “Urlaŋana ku ta ikamke u kek. La raama lelem ambai.”
